The architecture and flow can be modeled now, but the exact executable representation of the continuous ramp affects whether the current is only stepped at transition boundaries or represented continuously between them.
questions.suggested_value: Represent the ramp as a documented source schedule in this handoff, with the 0.10 s and 0.50 s operating transitions present and the continuous linear ramp behavior stated in documentation for Stage 3 realization.
